newsitem.title: USA: US high-yld fund inflows $371.3 mln in latest week.
newsitem.headline: US high-yld fund inflows $371.3 mln in latest week.

text.p: Cash inflows to high-yield corporate bond mutual funds totaled $371.3 million in the week ended May 14, according to AMG Data Services.
While positive, the number represented a dramatic slowdown from record setting inflows of $1.34 billion and $760 million in the weeks ending May 7 and April 30, respectively.
Inflows for the past five weeks total more than $3 billion. That compares to the $1.58 billion in high-yield fund cash outflows in the four-week period from March 12 through April 9.
The figures represent cash flows to and from high high-yield mutual funds that report on a weekly basis.
AMG, based in Arcata, Calif., is a U.S. mutual fund information company.
